normalization_rules: Never infer a reward from a character appearing in a PQ; only create a reward edge when the source explicitly lists the reward.
Keep clothing, accessories, Super Souls and skills as separate relationship types even when they share a PQ.
DLC edges identify the content pack required for the PQ, not ownership of every reward unless independently verified.
A farming edge means the PQ is documented as a practical farming route; it does not imply guaranteed drops.
Preserve source conflicts instead of silently choosing one value.
expansion_queue: Populate every Super Soul reward edge for PQ 1-186.
Populate every clothing/accessory reward edge for PQ 1-186.
Resolve reward-slot attribution and Ultimate Finish gating where sources disagree.
Add reverse indexes: skill -> PQs, Super Soul -> PQs, equipment -> PQs, character -> PQs, DLC -> PQs.
